reason: Identity was authenticated via the second email, so the main failure mode is not authentication. However, the request is high-risk: the user asks to cancel all unshipped orders and return everything from all delivered orders in one go. Policy requires status checks per order, explicit item lists, payment-method selection for refunds, and explicit user confirmation before any cancel/return; several orders were looked up only in proposed parallel calls that have not returned. The agent also proposed multiple simultaneous tool calls despite the policy limit of one tool call at a time. These visible scope/confirmation/process issues make an unsuccessful or policy-violating interaction plausible.
